'''Shas Vadde''' was a [[Fondorian]] who served as the [[President/Legends|president]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[41 ABY]], he supported the [[Confederation]], but after [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] began bombing [[Oridin City|Oridin]] in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] he surrendered to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]. Later, he would allow Niathal to set up a [[Alliance-in-exile|government in exile]] on Fondor after breaking away from Solo.
